meta.title: Mausam AI
meta.description: Personalised Weather Intelligence for every citizen, every crop and every journey.

hero.title: Weather that knows
hero.subtitle: Mausam AI turns raw observations into persona-specific decisions — when to run, when to spray, when to travel, when to stay indoors. Every card explains exactly why it appeared.

livePanel.title: Live decision preview
livePanel.hint: Rendered from the same JSON contract the dashboard uses

problem.title: Weather apps answer the wrong question
problem.description: A forecast tells you the temperature. It does not tell you whether to take the run, spray the field, or send the child to school. The last mile between a number and a decision is still manual.

points.title: One forecast for everyone
points.description: A farmer, a marathoner and a parent get the identical screen for a completely different day.

points.title: Data is scattered across agencies
points.description: IMD, CPCB and state departments publish separate feeds that never meet in one decision surface.

points.title: No explanation, no trust
points.description: Alerts arrive as bare warnings. Citizens cannot tell why a decision was recommended or when it will change.

solution.title: A decision layer above the forecast
solution.description: Mausam AI ingests the observation, resolves it against a persona profile, and outputs ranked actions with the reasoning attached. The same architecture scales from a school gate to an agricultural block.

bullets.text: Persona-first rendering — widgets, alerts and advice rebuild for the selected profile.
Explainability on every card: contributing factors, thresholds and confidence score.
Composite risk index weighted by hazard type, not a single weather number.
A simulation layer lets judges test any scenario without touching a backend.

pillars.label: Reason

pillars.label: Explain

features.title: Built for every citizen, engineered for scale
features.description: Every module is driven by structured JSON, so swapping the local files for API responses requires no UI change.

items.title: Persona Engine
items.description: Five personas — Runner, Farmer, Traveler, Parent, Health Conscious — each with a distinct widget set and rule base.

items.title: Live Simulation Panel
items.description: Change persona, condition, city, daypart, temperature, AQI, humidity, rain, UV and wind. The dashboard re-solves instantly.

items.title: Composite Risk Meter
items.description: A weighted circular gauge reading Safe, Moderate, High or Extreme, decomposed into the factors that produced it.

items.title: Explainability Panel
items.description: The 'why am I seeing this' layer: selected persona, the threshold crossed, the impact on the user and the confidence score.

items.title: 7-Day Outlook
items.description: Day-by-day cards with condition, range and rain probability, plus hourly trend charts for the selected daypart.

items.title: Ranked Alerts
items.description: Official warnings and model-generated advisories merged into one severity-ranked feed with prescribed actions.

flow.title: Observation to decision in four steps

steps.title: Ingest
steps.description: Surface, satellite and air quality feeds normalised into one observation schema.

steps.title: Resolve
steps.description: Values are adjusted for location, daypart and the persona's own thresholds.

steps.title: Reason
steps.description: Rule bases rank actions and generate persona-specific widgets with confidence scores.

steps.title: Deliver
steps.description: A single surface delivers the decision, the risk and the full reasoning trace.

stats.label: Re-solve time
stats.description: Local JSON, no network round trip

cta.title: Open the live dashboard
cta.description: Pick a persona, drag a slider and watch the entire intelligence surface rebuild. Nothing leaves your browser.

footer.note: Mausam AI - personalised weather intelligence for every citizen, every crop and every journey.
